question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Abandon
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"abandon"** means to leave a place, thing, or person permanently or for a lengthy period; to desert. (त्याग देना)

 
 
• **Example: **Due to the unavoidable circumstances, they had to abandon their home and move elsewhere.
 
 
 
• **Adopt** refers to the act of legally taking another's child and bringing it up as one's own, or to take up an idea, method, or course of action. (दत्तक लेना / अपनाना)
 
 
• **Example: **They decided to **adopt** a new strategy to improve sales.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Adopt**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Randomize** (अनियमित करना): To make something happen in a non-regular pattern or in any order.

 
 
• **Example:** The study's participants were randomized to minimize bias.
 
 
 
• **Destroy** (नष्ट करना): To damage something so badly that it cannot be repaired.
 
 
• **Example: **The hurricane could destroy many houses along the coast.
 
 
 
• **Surrender** (आत्मसमर्पण करना): To stop resisting an enemy or opponent and submit to their authority.
 
 
• **Example:** After a long battle, the troops were forced to surrender.
